## Projects
- Game Level Difficulty Balancer: An algorithmic solution that dynamically optimizes game difficulty curves using DAA principles — ensuring engaging, balanced gameplay. (https://github.com/sudeenjain/DAA-miniproject)
- Book Recommender System: An intelligent book recommendation engine built with Advanced Java that suggests titles based on user reading preferences and behavior patterns. (https://github.com/sudeenjain/Adavanced-Java-BookRecommender)
- IBM ML Recommender: A Python-based collaborative filtering system that leverages machine learning to predict user preferences and generate personalized recommendations. (https://github.com/sudeenjain/IBM-miniproject)
- Interactive Recipe Finder: A dynamic web application enabling users to search, filter, and discover recipes with real-time ingredient matching and beautiful UI. (https://github.com/sudeenjain/-interactive-recipe-finder)
- Currency Converter: A real-time currency exchange tool that connects to live APIs — supporting 150+ currencies with instant conversion rates and clean interface. (https://github.com/sudeenjain/currency-converter)
- Smart To-Do List: A Python-powered task management application with priority sorting, deadline tracking, and persistent storage for efficient productivity. (https://github.com/sudeenjain/to-do-list-in-python)
- Gesture Flow: A gesture-controlled interface that interprets hand movements in real time to drive on-screen actions and interactions. (https://github.com/sudeenjain/guesture_flow)
- Attendance Tracker: A web-based attendance management system for recording, tracking, and reviewing attendance records efficiently. (https://github.com/sudeenjain/attendence_tracker)
- Movie Recommendation: A recommendation engine that suggests movies to users based on content similarity and viewing preferences. (https://github.com/sudeenjain/Movie_Recommendation)
- Portfolio Website: An earlier version of this personal portfolio site, showcasing projects, certifications, and skills. (https://github.com/sudeenjain/portfolio)
- FolioAI: An AI-powered portfolio assistant that helps generate and organize portfolio content automatically. (https://github.com/sudeenjain/folioAI)
- CareerReady: A career-preparation platform helping users build job-readiness skills and track their progress. (https://github.com/sudeenjain/CarrerReady)
- Product Recommendation: An AI-driven recommendation system that suggests products to users based on browsing and purchase behavior. (https://github.com/sudeenjain/Product_Recommendation)
- Connects The Dots: An algorithmic visualization project exploring graph connectivity and pathfinding concepts, built as a DAA mini-project. (https://github.com/sudeenjain/Connect_the_Dots)
- Amazon Bestseller Recommender: A machine learning model that analyzes Amazon bestseller data to recommend similar high-performing products. (https://github.com/sudeenjain/Amazon-Bestseller-Recommender)
- AI Dictionary: An AI-powered dictionary tool offering smart word definitions, usage examples, and contextual understanding. (https://github.com/sudeenjain/AI_dictonary)
